content.comment_body: For some unknown reason, when I attempt to modify an existing project ([product_name] [version_no]), which I have edited many times before, the application freezes. Occasionally, I see a java heap space error, or sometimes it simply prevents me from running a connection that previously worked (I had deleted it and tried to re-run). The program memory is far from its limit. I've restarted the application, the software, and even rebooted the PC. According to 'system info': Total Java Memory: 259,522 kB Free Java Memory: 177,160 kB I haven't found any guidance on resolving this and feel stuck. I can share screenshots or more info if needed, but assistance seems unavailable for this constant freezing issue. Thanks, [user_name]

After discussing with technical support, I learned that a combination of the original software version, the upgraded version, and the current Java installation may be behind the problem. I was advised to recreate my entire project using the latest revision of [product_name], as a workaround. Sharing here in case others encounter a similar issue.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced repeated software freezes and 'java heap space error' while updating an existing project in [product_name], regardless of available memory and restart efforts. Tech support indicated that conflicts between older, upgraded software versions and current Java environments might be the cause. The advised solution was to rebuild the project in the newest version of [product_name], highlighting issues with compatibility and reliability when mixing legacy and recent software components.
analysis.user_expectations: User wants reliable project editing and connection features, free from memory-related errors, especially for projects well within resource limits and which previously functioned correctly.
